subject: Copywriting
title: The Anti-Sell Approach
description: A fast breakdown of The Anti-Sell Approach for builders.

hook.text: Hermès has a waitlist for its Birkin bag. You can't buy one by asking—you must be invited.

buildup.text: Luxury brands don't chase customers. They signal that the customer must prove worthy. The power dynamic is reversed.

twist.text: The anti-sell creates desire through exclusion.

climax.text: The anti-sell only works for true luxury.

punchline.text: Don't ask to buy. Be invited to own. Luxury reverses the power dynamic.

quiz.question: What does the 'anti-sell' approach do?
options: Reverses the power dynamic so the customer must prove worthy
